question.text: The transverse displacement of a wave on string is given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext mathvariant="italic">y</mtext><mfenced><mtext mathvariant="italic">x, t</mtext></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msup><mtext>e</mtext><mrow><mo>-</mo><mfenced><mrow><msup><mtext mathvariant="italic">ax</mtext><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mtext mathvariant="italic">bt</mtext><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mtext mathvariant="italic">ab</mtext></msqrt><mtext mathvariant="italic"> xt</mtext></mrow></mfenced></mrow></msup></math>, this represents a _______

options.text: Wave moving along + x-axis with speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mfrac><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac></msqrt></math>
Wave moving along - x-axis with speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mfrac><mi>b</mi><mi>a</mi></mfrac></msqrt></math>

solution.text:
General equation of travelling wave is

y=fax ± bt=fx ± vt

y=e-ax2+bt2+2ab xt=e-ax +b t 2

So, the wave will be travelling along - x-axis with speed ba.
